items.title: Bill Phillips Interview, 1961-05-24
items.q: I was playing fumes with Chris Kelly and Buddy

ctx.x: They make them ball bearing and water and fire.

Yeah, yeah, they're very fast, they're very fast today. There's a lot of difference, and then they're not, you see? There's something, you got to do it. Even you take the fumes, long years ago, I was playing fumes with Chris Kelly and Buddy and then they got the fumes more since the day, you play, you play, four beats still measure, but at that time you hit that bass, 12 hit one, and the stage on the four, three. The generator. That's the many players today, you see? Long years ago, they got one beat on that bass…
Yeah, one, two, three, four. Why do you think they changed the style like that?
